snippet.title: Baba Records | Gameplay Trailer | Business Sim, Pixel Art, Indie
snippet.description:
In this retro pixel-art record store management game, step into the shoes of Aziz Üsküdar, a seasoned record dealer in Istanbul, and turn his little record shop into a name worthy of the Utrecht Record Fair — in just 60 days.

Baba Records is OUT NOW on itch.io!
Play here 👉 https://peachpanicgames.itch.io/baba-records
